questions.q: An arrangement by which a company undertakes to provide a guarantee of compensation for specified loss, damage, illness, or death in return for the payment of a specified premium is known as
questions.explain: **Insurance** is an aid to trade that protects individuals and businesses from the financial consequences of risks and unforeseen losses by pooling resources.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The regular monetary payment made by an insured person to the insurance company in exchange for risk protection services is called the
questions.explain: To enjoy insurance services, the insured must pay a regular agreed amount of money called a **premium** to the insurer.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The specific insurance policy that protects a business against financial loss arising from the destruction of its factory buildings or goods by uncontrolled flames is
questions.explain: **Fire insurance** policies are designed specifically to compensate businesses and individuals for property damage caused by accidental fires.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which type of insurance policy is legally required for any business owner who uses distribution vans and trucks on public roads?
questions.explain: **Vehicle (or motor) insurance** covers risks associated with automobiles, such as accidents, theft, and third-party liabilities. It is mandatory for road users.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: An importer bringing a large shipment of electronics by sea will take out which insurance policy to protect the goods from shipwrecks or piracy?
questions.explain: **Marine insurance** covers the loss or damage of ships, cargo, terminals, and any transport by which goods are transferred across water.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The term 'assurance' rather than 'insurance' is used for life policies because
options: the event insured against (death) is bound to happen eventually
the premiums paid are relatively cheaper than other policies
it completely stops the insured person from dying
the government fully sponsors the policy for everyone
questions.explain: In business studies, **assurance** applies to events that are a certainty (like death, though the time is unknown), whereas *insurance* applies to risks that may or may not happen (like a fire).
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A shop owner takes out a policy to receive compensation in case thieves forcefully break into the premises at night and steal goods. This policy is called
questions.explain: **Burglary insurance** (or theft insurance) provides coverage against loss or damage to property resulting from a break-in or forceful entry.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The insurance policy specifically designed to help workers save money during their active working years so they can receive a regular income after they retire is the
questions.explain: A **Pension scheme** or policy acts as a long-term savings plan that provides a financial safety net and regular income to individuals after they reach retirement age.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: To offset the high costs of medical treatments, surgeries, and hospital admissions for its employees, a company will provide
questions.explain: **Health insurance** covers the medical and surgical expenses incurred by the insured, making healthcare accessible and affordable.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following are major benefits of insurance to a business organization EXCEPT
options: it guarantees business continuity after a disaster
it prevents any form of risk or accident from physically occurring
it provides peace of mind to the entrepreneur
insurance policies can serve as collateral for bank loans
questions.explain: Insurance provides financial compensation and peace of mind, but it **does not physically prevent accidents or risks** (like a fire) from occurring in the first place.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
